title: Charlton Aria Acquisition Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-27
summary: Charlton Aria Acquisition Corp, a SPAC listed on Nasdaq (tickers: CHARU, CHAR, CHARR), filed an 8-K disclosing an extension of its business combination deadline from April 25, 2026 to July 25, 2026. The sponsor (ST Sponsor II Limited) deposited $850,000 into the trust account to enable the extension. The company also issued an $850,000 promissory note for the extension and a $500,000 working capital note to the sponsor.
key_points: SPAC deadline extended from April 25, 2026 to July 25, 2026 (3-month extension)
Sponsor deposited $850,000 into trust account to trigger the extension
Company may extend up to two additional 3-month periods with $850,000 per extension ($1.7M total)
Issued $850,000 unsecured promissory note to sponsor (Extension Note, no interest)
Issued $500,000 unsecured promissory note to sponsor for working capital (Working Capital Note, no interest)
Units and underlying securities are not transferable until business combination completion
